Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — really useful to understand Nimbus Health's production plans. Quick recap from our side: 
- Primary use: real-time clinical note summarization and triage (API call per note).
- Current estimate: ~100–150 RPS at peak, seasonal bursts up to ~300 RPS.
- Latency target: p95 <= 150ms for short prompts (under 512 tokens).

Next step: we'd like to schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) with your infra/ML engineering lead so our Solutions team can size Dedicated capacity and run throughput/latency projections. Can you confirm who should join from Nimbus? I included a capacity template (capacity_template.xlsx) to capture your traffic profile — filling a couple of fields beforehand will make the call much more efficient.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 26 May, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 27 May, 09:00–10:00
- Wed 27 May, 15:00–16:00

If none of those work, tell me a couple of times that do and we'll coordinate. I'll loop in Rishi (Solutions) and Priyom (AE) on the calendar invite.

Thanks — happy to move forward. Catherine (cc'd) is our infra lead and should join the sizing call. A few datapoints up-front to help Rishi size things:
- Current production traffic: ~120 RPS average, peaks ~260 RPS during batch ingestion windows.
- Typical request: ~400 tokens total (prompt + response).
- Latency target: p95 <= 100–120ms for real-time requests; async/batch tolerates higher.
- Model: currently evaluating a mix of open LLM variants; we expect to standardize on a 7B or 13B variant for cost/latency tradeoffs.

We can do Tue 26 May 10:00 PT or Wed 27 May 09:00 PT — prefer the Tue slot. Please send a calendar invite and include any pre-read or sizing template. Also, data residency/compliance is important for us — Catherine will bring the security questions.
